//: A small services business with clients. Copy to ../org.config.json and edit the roots.

org.name: Atelier
org.tagline: win it, build it, remember it

departments.name: Pipeline
departments.mission: Keep the pipeline warm without posting into the void.
departments.note: Measure conversations started and calls booked. Impressions are not a pipeline metric and tracking them will make you feel productive while nothing happens.

items.label: voice-profile
items.desc: Who you are, who you serve, and the phrases you never use. Maintain this above everything else.

items.label: post-engine
items.desc: Generates and queues daily posts for review before publishing.

items.label: call-attribution
items.desc: Nothing links a booked call back to the post that caused it, so you cannot tell which content sells.

items.label: proposal-tpl
items.desc: No proposal template, so every pitch is written from scratch under time pressure.

items.label: case-studies
items.desc: Proof, with numbers the client agreed to.

departments.name: Delivery
departments.mission: Ship what was sold, on the scope that was sold.
departments.note: One folder per client, flat. Scope changes get logged the day they happen, not at invoice time.

items.label: client-folders
items.desc: One per client: scope, contacts, decisions, invoices.

items.label: scope-log
items.desc: Scope creep is noticed at invoice time instead of when it happens.

items.label: starter-kit
items.desc: The repo every engagement forks from.

departments.name: Ops
departments.mission: Invoice on time and know the margin per engagement.
departments.note: Hours against fixed price is the number that decides whether an engagement was worth taking. Record it while you remember.

items.label: rate-card
items.desc: What you charge and what you stopped charging for.

items.label: margin-per-job
items.desc: Nothing records hours against fixed price, so profitability per client is a guess.

departments.name: Memory
departments.mission: Hold what the other departments need to remember.
departments.note: Client context is the most expensive thing to lose and the easiest to leave in a chat window.

items.label: vault-mcp
items.desc: Reads and writes the vault directly.

items.label: search-order
items.desc: Client folder first, knowledge second, archive never unless asked.
